title: Deadline-Bound Fan-Out with TaskGroup
instructions: Implement `fan_out(factories, *, timeout)` in `fanout.py`. It calls every zero-argument coroutine factory inside an `asyncio.TaskGroup`, under one shared `asyncio.timeout`, and returns the results in input order. A failing call must cancel its siblings and surface as an `ExceptionGroup`; an expired deadline must cancel everything and raise `TimeoutError`.

evidence.label: Returns results in input order, not completion order
Runs the calls concurrently, not one after another
Cancels siblings (finally blocks run) and raises an ExceptionGroup on failure
Reports every failure in the ExceptionGroup without unwrapping it
Cancels all calls and raises TimeoutError when the deadline passes
